commands.command: cargo clippy -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-machine -p quansio-server --all-targets -- -D warnings  # exit captured before filtering
git clone . && arch_check.py && pytest tests/architecture && validate_v81.py  # on a clean clone: 129 passed, validator PASS
gen_contracts.py --check --only catalog,openapi,sdk,ts,rust  # SendBrowserInput keeps its name; no generated artifact moved
cd apps/desktop && tsc --noEmit && eslint src tests

cd apps/desktop && vitest run  # dev stack up, all 68 files: 676 passed, 4 skipped (pre-existing). New: a key press is a named key, a grapheme as text, or nothing (chords stay with the person); a wheel turn is scaled from the displayed picture to the page and clamped; the key and scroll commands are built from exactly what the server accepts and travel the one channel; the live view sends input only while the person holds the session

cargo test --no-fail-fast -p quansio-machine -p quansio-qworkerd -p quansio-server  # 1334 passed, 0 failed, on a default stack. worker_live (13) against real PostgreSQL, a real worker, a real Chrome and a real WebSocket against the served router: a viewer who joins before the browser exists, and one who joins after, both see the agent work (the late one is given a current picture); with no viewer nothing is streamed; the stream follows the agent's newer tab; two viewers keep it, the last leaving stops it (an animated page plus a positive control that pictures really flow, so silence means something) and returning viewers find frame numbers that never went backwards; a person's Enter, Backspace, ArrowDown and scroll reach a real page; every key off the allowlist and every out-of-bounds scroll is refused at the control plane, and orders sent straight to the worker bypassing it are refused by the driver. daemon_orders: a frame the worker cannot read is skipped, not fatal

mutation checks, all KILLED: W1-W7 (last viewer leaving does not stop the stream [killed only after the test was rewritten], a joining viewer does not start it, the host does not ask after the browser is created, the worker does not follow a newer tab, a late viewer gets no picture, frame numbers restart, the host streams with no viewer); K1-K5 (server accepts any key, server does not bound a scroll, worker accepts any key, worker does not bound a scroll, an unreadable frame ends the connection); T1-T3 (desktop forwards a chord, sends a key it was not allowed, does not clamp a scroll); every mutant compiles; the restored control passes
